coordinate_space.units: normalized_uv_0_to_1 inside that part's opaque-tight bbox padded to authored canvas
coordinate_space.also_provide: pixel_hint relative to recommended master assemble 512x768 with feet on bottom center

hips.notes: Pelvis center under shorts; RUN cycle root.

torso.notes: Pivot at waist/hips join. Include shorts top + raglan torso. Neck stump at top-center ~uv (0.5, 0.08).

head.notes: Pivot at neck base under chin/headband. Hair spikes may extend above canvas; keep transparent margin >= 8 px.

upper_arm_l.side: far (behind when facing right in default RUN contact)
upper_arm_l.notes: Pivot at shoulder under raglan seam. Elbow end overlaps forearm.

forearm_l.notes: Includes dark glove/fist for RUN POC. Pivot at elbow.

upper_arm_r.notes: Mirror of L with raglan black panel continuity.

forearm_r.notes: Includes glove/fist. Near-arm usually highest z in RUN.

thigh_l.notes: Maroon + shorts underside paint. Pivot at hip socket under shorts.

shin_l.notes: Maroon mid-calf length. Knee overlap pad required.

shoe_l.notes: Yellow/white sneaker. Pivot at ankle; sole contact for RUN.

thigh_r.notes: Leading/trailing depends on RUN phase; keep L/R distinct PNGs.

validation.pivot_marker_in_png: forbidden (metadata only — do not bake red dots into art)
